#### 1. autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia, deafness and narcolepsy  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.783)

**How to falsify it:** The absence of pathogenic variants in DNMT1 in individuals with these distinct phenotypes, or the identification of distinct causal genes for each disease that do not converge on DNA methylation pathways. _(variant: gnomad_v3.1.2 has no reported pathogenic variants in DNMT1 that are clearly associated with either disease.)_
